description: Search Anaella's capability catalog by what you want to do. Everything Anaella does is in it: email (read, search, send on Gmail, Outlook / Microsoft 365 or any IMAP mailbox: email.messages.list, email.message.get, email.attachment.read, email.message.send), calendar (Google or Outlook: calendar.availability.get, calendar.event.create), Google Sheets (sheets.read, sheets.append…), Google Drive and Docs (drive.files.search, drive.file.read, docs.create), Slack (slack.channels.list, slack.messages.list, slack.message.send), watches that report new items (watch.create, watch.events.list), automations where an AI agent handles new items with your instructions, writes waiting for approval (automation.create, automation.action.decide), SEO (gsc.*), Analytics (analytics.report), Meta and Google Ads, Google reviews, social comments (social.comments.*), social posting and analytics (social.post.create, social.posts.list, social.post.analytics…), media (media.upload, image generation, stock), web search and page reading. Examples: "read my inbox", "free time tomorrow", "append a row to a sheet", "schedule a post", "automate replies to new emails". Returns ids, summaries, prices and whether the account is connected. Free. Then explain the id, then do it.

category.description: Only this family, e.g. email, calendar, ads, seo, media, social, stripe; "raw" also lists raw pass-through calls
